sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash/FlashX - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash has 320B total parameters with 18B activated. As the first open-source frontier model to combine sparse and linear attention, it significantly cuts computation and serving costs while preserving long-context quality — reducing attention computation and KV cache by 3.01× and 4.44× versus GLM-5.3. Native Multimodal Visual Coding

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is the first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.
